environment.contention: first ~30min of daily phase ran under unrelated headless-Chrome CPU load (load avg 12-22); stuck renderer (376996, 2h12m CPU in 3h11m) killed at ~05:00 local, after which load dropped to ~1 and chunk latency fell 150-190s -> 5-6s

scale.gap_cause: official package has no .day member for these symbols (data gap, not a system failure)

daily_collection.method: start_collection via MCP, explicit selections of 100 entities per task

task_exec_clean_run.note: 45 tasks measured after Chrome contention removed (resumed run, warm page cache)

yearly_derivation.method: update_data dataset=market.yearly via MCP, 100 items per task, per-item years intersected with daily availability (2025, 2026)

crash_recovery_evidence.event: root filesystem filled to 100% during daily phase (unrelated /tmp scratch from prior sessions); data_service exited with STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: disk I/O error; systemd restarted it 136+ times until space freed
crash_recovery_evidence.task_state: in-flight chunk-7 task observed as needs_verification ('old run or unresolved execution') - fail-closed
crash_recovery_evidence.resolution: verify_stopped_writes via MCP -> task marked interrupted, range locks released; resubmitted selection succeeded 100/100
crash_recovery_evidence.duplicate_protection: re-submission of already-published entities rejected with INVALID_MARKET_COMMAND 'existing daily head requires the update_data range path' (2 chunks, 200 items) - CAS semantics intact
crash_recovery_evidence.request_identity: re-using request_id with different payload rejected REQUEST_CONFLICT - durable request identity intact

integrity.shell_sqlite_bypass: none in data path (read-only diagnostics only)

targets_assessment.yearly_lt_15min: 1036s task-sum NOT MET (1356s e2e incl. precheck+polling)
